love that Child Safety Standards

love that is an 18+ service and does not permit children to use dating or adult-chat functionality.

Zero tolerance

We prohibit child sexual abuse and exploitation, grooming, sexual solicitation of minors, and creation, upload or distribution of child sexual abuse material.

Reporting

Users can report safety concerns in the app. Reports involving suspected child sexual exploitation are escalated for urgent review and handled in accordance with applicable law.

Point of contact

Before public release, the operator must publish a monitored child-safety contact address in this section and in the relevant store-console declarations.
